attributes.personal_statement:
I am a Junior Generative AI Engineer with a solid foundation in Software Engineering (MERN stack), I specialize in utilizing the power of AI to solve complex problems and drive solutions. My expertise spans fine-tuning large language models (LLMs), building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, and developing advanced chatbots.

Starting from a software engineering background, I have rapidly grown my skills in generative AI, becoming adept at evaluating, optimizing, and enhancing AI workflows. I thrive on the intersection of technology and creativity, constantly pushing the boundaries of what AI can achieve.

In addition to my technical skills, I am deeply passionate about the potential of AI to create positive change, particularly in education. I envision utilizing Generative AI to provide high-quality education and solve real-world problems, making a tangible impact on society.

Let's connect and see how we can collaborate to advance the field of AI and create innovative solutions for the future.

attributes.title: Amharic news Classifier
attributes.summary: an AI chatbot that is capable of classifying Amharic news data into categories such as Sport, Business, Entertainment, Politics, International and local news. Implemented using BERT-small-Amharic model, React js with Tailwind CSS, Flask API and Amharic news dataset from Kaggle, labeled by category

attributes.title: Legal contract advisor RAG
attributes.summary: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system for contract Q&A, enabling users to pose questions and receive relevant answers. Implemented using langchain, chroma db, GPT-4 model and RAGAS for evaluating performance.

attributes.summary:
Responsible for managing implementation phase of an Intelligent Transportation Software System
developed for Addis Ababa City Bus Authority. The system is a huge lOT based software used for smart
bus dispatching and monitoring. My responsibilities are to manage the training and evaluation dispatcher
to use the system effectively, Execute test plans to ensure reliability and performance, keep log and
report of software defects, prepare manual and technical documentations, give the appropriate technical
and business demonstration of the system as necessary. As of now I’ve successfully managed the pilot
implementation phase on 177 routes.

Trained under intensive project based learning environment, contributing to over 10 projects spanning machine learning, generative AI and data engineering  domains.
Developed hands-on proficiency in fine-tuning and prompt engineering techniques, leveraging diverse LLM models to optimize AI performance.
Mastered data engineering workflows using Airflow, facilitating efficient data processing and pipeline management.
Gained practical experience in constructing RAG pipelines, enhancing AI systems' ability to access and process information from various sources.
Explored and utilized different Machine learning models.

Web dashboard planning, designing and prototype development using Flutter web, BLOC, Node/Express
and MongoDB. The company has another service provider system that was on work, however it was
very difficult to manage the clients and the revenue generated. I managed to design and develop a
working prototype dashboard to effectively manage transaction and client management data, which
resulted in positive impact on the company’s sales and revenue.

Mobile application development, testing and maintenance using Flutter/Dart, GetX, GraphQL api. My
responsibility was to add new features, fix bugs and refactor a mobile application code base. I was able to achieve a more cleaner, testable and maintainable code structure, which leads to minimized bugs and scaled
by new features
Front-End Web application development using React.js, Tailwind CSS and Redux library. I developed an
e-commerce like website for a company, which was later customized a little and reused to develop
similar platform.
